title: Rename Semio Server to Semio Hub
description: Rename the semio server technology/module to semio hub across the semio/ codebase. The hub directory already exists (Cargo.toml, bin.rs, compose.yml, k8s.yaml); the old semio/server directory is empty. Update all references (paths, identifiers, comments, configs) in semio/ to use "hub" instead of "server" where they refer to the semio server subsystem. Do not touch repo/ (different technology). Remove the stale empty semio/server directory at the end.
summary:
Refactored centralized logging to clean architecture with ONE central gate instead of scattered logging calls.

Architecture:
- `SketchpadStore.logInteraction()` is the single central log method (interactionLog[] with 500-entry rolling buffer)
- Three infrastructure gates feed into it automatically:
  1. **Actor proxy** in `setActor()` — wraps `actor.send` so ALL XState events are logged at the source, zero manual calls needed in any hook
  2. **`SketchpadStore.executeCommand()`** — logs sketchpad-level commands (createKit, openKit, etc.)
  3. **Per-store `logCommand()`** in KitAppStoreImpl, DesignStore, QualityAppStore — forwards store command logs to centralized log

Reverted all 37 scattered `store.logInteraction()` calls that were manually added in hooks (useTheme, useLanguage, useDevice, useMode, useExpertise, useFullscreen, useSketchpadActions, useXStateField, useXStateFieldWithScope, useXStateAction, useHomeCommands). Hooks are now clean — they just call `actor.send()` which is automatically intercepted by the proxy.
